summary: Based on Q1 2024 financials showing elevated leverage and ample liquidity, the leverage and liquidity covenants were tightened (C01, C03) while other covenants remained unchanged, constituting a material drift in the candidate package.

clauses.rationale: Q1 2024 EBITDA $11.7M with non‑vehicle net debt $203.4M suggests leverage likely exceeds 4.25×, weakening assumption A01; tighten leverage permission.
clauses.change: Change from permitting ratio >4.25 to imposing a maximum ratio of 4.25 (or lower).

evidence.quote: Cash and Restricted Cash as of March 31, 2024 totaled approximately $63.4 million, and non-vehicle net debt was $203.4 million.
Adjusted EBITDA was $11.7 million, compared to $10.8 million or an improvement of 8.3%.

clauses.rationale: No evidence of change in senior secured leverage or debt composition; assumption A04 unchanged.
Liquidity consistently exceeds $25M (e.g., $212.7M in Q1 2024), supporting assumption A02; tighten liquidity covenant to require minimum $25M.
clauses.change: Change from permitting liquidity <$25M to requiring liquidity ≥$25M.

evidence.quote: Total Available Liquidity, defined as unrestricted cash plus availability under floor plan credit facilities at March 31, 2024, totaled approximately $212.7 million.

clauses.rationale: No evidence indicating need to alter financial statement delivery frequency or scope.
No evidence suggesting change to compliance certificate requirement.
No evidence indicating change to notice of default obligations.

drift_reasons: Tightened leverage and liquidity covenants based on evidence of high leverage and strong liquidity.
